judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after the test/spec planning phase (red phase of TDD) and never implemented the actual production change in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `lastUsage = outcome.usage ?? lastUsage` was left untouched, the newly added acceptance test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestratorUsage.acceptance.test.ts` fails immediately on `npm test`. Additionally, the candidate failed to update the hook signature parameter name (`totalUsage`), missed the required `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and left an untracked `.lore/dod.md` file in the repository. It did, however, write a valid test covering the multi-round accumulation and partial-reporting acceptance criteria and updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`.
